notes: • Backups without a server: Settings ▸ Backup copies every matter with all its files, encrypted with your password, to an external disk, a NAS or a cloud-drive folder — daily, each file once; restore on any Mac. LitArbi warns when a matter exists only on this Mac and checks Time Machine. • Shared matters: Matter ▸ Recently Deleted on the Server… and Exhibit ▸ History on the Server… bring back deleted exhibits and earlier versions (LitArbi Server 1.2).
